maria: Thanks everyone — quick follow-up thread from today’s all-hands. If you asked something live or flagged an item in chat, drop it here and I’ll route to the right owner. Recording + slides: https://redwood-internal.company/all-hands/mar-2026 (slides) and https://zoom.company/rec/abcdef (recording)

sam: Quick clarification on the roadmap note — when I said ‘Q3 surface area’, I meant feature gating for Dedicated autoscaling, not the Dedicated GA date. GA timeline still end of Q2 as discussed.

lee: Confirming — Dedicated GA: beta customers next week, GA target 2026-06-15. Will post short checklist for beta acceptance criteria.

anish: Thanks — can you add the on-prem/Private packaging timeline? Some enterprise customers asked for an installable bundle.

lee: Yep. Private on-prem alpha for partners -> late Q3. Public private package (air-gapped) planning in Q4. I’ll add a short RFC link here shortly.

kevin: Could we get a clear SLA doc pointer for sales/customer questions? I asked in the chat but didn’t see a link.

devex-bot: SLA draft (internal) is in Confluence: https://confluence.company/infra/sla-draft (readers: internal-only)

maria: Action items from me: 1) @lee — post beta acceptance checklist & RFC link by Thu 2026-03-26. 2) @sam — publish clarified roadmap blurb for external PS by Fri. 3) @kevin — create one-pager SLA FAQ for sales, ping me for review.

kevin: I’ll make the one-pager. Will reuse the SLA draft link and add common Qs/answer bullets. ETA EOD Fri.

anish: For customers asking about migration from hosted -> Dedicated, can we get migration playbook? Even a short checklist would help.

lee: Good call. I’ll spin up a migration playbook skeleton and ask Solutions to populate with runbook steps. Owner: @lee, target Wed next week.

maria: If anyone from the meeting still has unanswered questions, drop them here or DM me. I’ll close this thread once the three owners post updates. :thumbsup:
